trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn all other 54 trophies. This unlocks automatically when the platinum requirements are met. No separate action needed.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission "Gone Fishing" which serves as the tutorial. It introduces basic controls, combat, and driving. Cannot be missed — it's the first mission.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish all missions in Chapter 1. This chapter establishes the setting and main characters. Progress naturally through the story.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish all missions in Chapter 2. The story expands to new areas and introduces key factions. Cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish all Chapter 3 missions. Major story developments occur here. Natural story progression.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 missions. This is the penultimate chapter before the finale. Story-only, cannot miss.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the game's final mission. This is a gold trophy and the story conclusion. Cannot be missed if you finish the game.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission "Breakfast Run" which appears during the story. It's a main mission, not a stranger strand.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the mission "The Cartel Heist" — a major story heist mission. Part of the main narrative.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission "Child's Play" — a story mission involving family dynamics. Main path, not missable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the mission "Headliners" — a story mission. Progress the narrative to unlock it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the mission "VCIA Takedown" — a story mission involving the VCIA agency. Main path.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission "Operation Savage Glory" — a story mission. Cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Achieve 100% game completion — all missions, collectibles, activities, and challenges. This is the biggest time investment. Do this last after everything else.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Perform 250 stunt jumps across Leonida. Stunt locations are marked on the map once discovered. Can be done anytime after unlocking the map. Silver trophy for the grind.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are 9 activity types in the game (racing, shooting range, drone racing, fishing, arcade, meditation, hunting, bowling, stunt jumps). Simply start each one once. Do this early while exploring.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges across multiple locations. Each requires Gold medal (high score + accuracy + time). Practice each, learn patterns. Silver trophy for mastery.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 Top Fun Drone Race locations across Leonida. Win each race (1st place) at least once. Drone controls take practice — use boost strategically.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 unique race events (street races, off-road, etc.). Each distinct race counts once. Can be done throughout the game. Focus on easier races first.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is a fishing challenger. Find his location, accept the challenge, and catch a larger/rarer fish than him. Fishing mechanics: cast, wait for bite, reel with tension management.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find any arcade cabinet (located in bars, arcades, malls) and play one game to completion (win or lose). Simple bronze — just interact with an arcade machine.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is a stranger with a mission strand. Complete all his missions, ending with his final one. Stranger missions appear as '?' on map. Do all 8 stranger strands for the silver trophy too.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's stranger strand. Complete all his missions. Part of the 8 strands needed for "Strangers & Freaks" silver.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's stranger strand. Finish all his missions for this bronze and progress toward the silver for 8 strands.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are exactly 8 stranger mission strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, plus 3 others). Complete all missions in all 8 strands. This is the main missable silver — do all stranger content before the final chapter.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's stranger strand. Complete his missions for this bronze and the Strangers & Freaks silver.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's stranger strand. Finish his missions for bronze and silver progress.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots scattered across the map. Interact at each to meditate. Spots are marked once discovered. Can be done anytime — not missable.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret is a hunter stranger. He tasks you with hunting a specific unique/legendary animal. Track it, hunt it, deliver. Part of a stranger strand.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible Cards are scattered across Leonida (52+ cards). They form sets. Complete any 3 full sets. Cards are found in specific locations — use map/guides. Silver for the collection effort.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK spots are photo-op locations (100 total). At each, use the WAiNK app to take a photo. Marked on map once near. Silver for completing all 100 — a major exploration trophy.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges are gameplay feats (kills with specific weapons, driving feats, etc.). 50 total across all categories. Many unlock naturally. Check Challenges menu for progress.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: During a mission with your partner (co-op story character), reach 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops together. Likely occurs in a specific story mission — just play naturally.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 stores consecutively while maintaining a wanted level (don't lose the cops). Likely a specific mission or free-roam activity with partner.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Enter/drive 100 unique vehicle models. The game has 100+ vehicles. Just drive everything you see — cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes. Natural through exploration.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-mo ability. Activate it when 5+ enemies are in view, then kill 5 before it ends. Do this in a combat-heavy mission or ambush.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: VCIA is a location/faction. "Unscheduled departure" means escaping dramatically — likely stealing a helicopter or plane from their facility during a mission or free roam.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhinos are tanks. This trophy likely requires destroying or surviving Rhino tanks. Could be in a mission or free roam military response. Engage tanks and deal with them.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Stealth robbery of a jewelry store. Enter quietly, avoid cameras/guards, grab loot, leave unseen. Can be done in free roam at jewelry store locations.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: There are 5 bank vault heists (distinct from story heists). Each requires planning/entry, cracking vault, escaping. Silver for completing all 5. Do them when available.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks spawn randomly or at fixed locations. Ram/stop the truck, blow doors, grab cash, escape police. One successful robbery = bronze.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Reveal all 52 named areas/regions on the map. Simply drive/fly/walk everywhere. Fog of war clears as you travel. Natural through 100% completion.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs in Leonida. Each has illegal operations (drug labs, chop shops, etc.). Rob one operation per gang (9 total). Map shows gang territories.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Ocean Beach is a district. Find a bar/restaurant there with a view, interact to drink a cocktail. Simple exploration trophy.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Find a vehicle showroom (dealership), drive a car through the window/wall to exit. "Classic style" references GTA Vice City. Just drive through the glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Specific bowling alley location (Kolt & Associates). Play a game of bowling there. Complete a frame or game. Simple activity trophy.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Likely a co-op/partner mission with a specific outcome. "Mass appeal" suggests a public spectacle. Play partner missions to unlock.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The game tracks choices (PSN shows a count to 500). Make 500 choices across dialogue, mission branching, etc. Accumulates naturally.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed at something on the second attempt after failing first. Could be a mission retry, challenge retry, or specific event. Happens naturally.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness a strange/secret event — likely an Easter egg (UFO, Bigfoot, ghost, etc.). Explore remote areas at night, check known mystery locations.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: While driving, perform a melee attack (drive-by) that knocks down multiple pedestrians like bowling pins. Find a crowd, drive through with melee equipped.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills are acquired from robberies/heists. Use contact missions/laundering mechanics to clean $250k total. Accumulates over time.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Cumulative spending at shops (clothing, weapons, vehicles, food, etc.). $100k total across the playthrough. Natural with normal play.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: There are 8 garage properties to buy. They unlock as you progress. Buy all 8 for vehicle storage. Bronze for the real estate portfolio.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Scooter Bros is an in-game app for vehicle registration. Register 10 different vehicles in the app. Drive a vehicle, open app, register it.
